newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Novus says on track to meet forecast.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Novus says on track to meet forecast.

text.p: Novus Petroleum Ltd said on Tuesday it was on track to meet its prospectus forecast for a full year after tax profit of A$19.9 million before abnormals.
"The first half result has Novus on track to achieve a 1996 after tax profit in line with our prospectus forecast of A$19.9 million," managing director Bob Williams said in a statement.
Earlier today, Novus reported a net profit after abnormals of A$8.94 million for the six months to June 30, up from A$3.04 million in the previous corresponding period.
The pre-abnormals net profit for the six month period was A$10.04 million.
Novus listed on the Australian Stock Exchange in May 1995.
Williams said while the company's performance was largely dependent on the oil price, all of its September quarter cargoes had already been committed and prices locked in.
He was however confident about the direction of oil prices in the short term.
"In any event, the current higher oil prices show few signs of abating in the short term," he said.
Novus shares closed two cents lower at A$1.83 on light turnover of 11,978 shares.
